source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Document everything that did not meet testing or was found to be missing (regardless of whether previous brake tests were done), whether or not the vehicle passed the test.
3. This saves time and avoids overlooking any findings.

-   Each defect must be documented with its own code and comment.
-   It is not valid to write a general "fail" comment describing all of the non-passing values on an inspection report, since this data will not be recorded electronically.

# Notes on failed test documentation

## General notes

-   Do not document a complete pass-or-fail description of the test in the comment field.
-   Document failed tests individually (these must have their own codes or comments).
-   The comment must include at least the following information:

1. A description of the defect and the required repair, and
2. The fault stage

-   Include a picture in some cases.
-
